title: Episode 083 — Elmer's Glue / Bobby Lee Channels David's Mom
summary: Episode 83 is an unusually clear record of a group turning one participant's unwanted ritual back into live entertainment. Bobby Lee says he has avoided the Elmer's-glue skin-peeling practice for two years, calls it compulsive, says the gift is hurtful temptation, then resumes while the room celebrates, imitates and repeatedly requests more. The archive preserves his own account without diagnosing him from an audience text: dermatillomania refers to recurrent skin picking, not automatically to applying and peeling school glue. Poison Control says most school glue is not poisonous but art products should be used according to their labels and not on skin or mucous membranes unless approved; solvent-glue inhalant risks should not be silently transferred to ordinary school glue. The later mother 'channeling' is an improvised Bobby Lee impersonation directed by David, not the mother's testimony. Its financial pressure, suicide/firearm threats and sexualized escalation are protected as nonparticipant family material; real suicide threats should be taken seriously, not dared or dismissed. The gambling account illustrates loss chasing and a Martingale-style doubling system, not a no-loss strategy. Wedding-address exposure, private partners and third-party health material are also withheld. The useful production layer concerns participant attention, phone rules, uneven invitations, status anxiety, direct communication, fan-site creativity, location episodes and the cost of manufacturing conflict for a show. Named dialogue remains withheld.
speaker_policy: UNKNOWN by default. Five coarse legacy windows and zero deliberately unrequested turns cannot support names. Cast names describe public episode participation only, never assign individual transcript lines.
sensitivity: Immutable ASR is preserved separately from public cleaned and editorial layers.
Five exact privacy and power-sensitive spans are filed in the shared redaction layer.
The mother's segment is indexed as an improvised impersonation, not first-person evidence from her.
Health, compulsive-behavior, suicide and gambling claims are contextualized, not silently rewritten.
Private partner identities and third-party health details are not reconstructed.
source_notes: All eighteen cleaner drops are empty zero-duration artifacts.

Poison Control: most school glue is not poisonous, but products should follow label directions and should not be used for skin painting or food decoration unless labeled for it: https://www.poison.org/articles/safe-use-of-art-products

Poison Control's inhalant warning concerns deliberate inhalation and particularly solvent-based glues; the episode uses Elmer's school glue and should not be mislabeled as solvent huffing: https://www.poison.org/articles/parents-must-know-about-inhalant-abuse
988 Lifeline guidance says take suicide threats seriously, do not dare a person, remove lethal means, and seek specialist help: https://988lifeline.org/help-someone-else/
The public fan-site lead is scrotumcoat.tumblr.com; existence and archival value still require page-level verification.
The vocabulary output still contains semantic rewrites and global name expansions; the accepted fixture rejects them.
